name: fuels-rs
readme_excerpt: fuels-rs Rust SDK for Fuel. It can be used for a variety of things, including but not limited to: - Compiling, deploying, and testing Sway contracts; - Launching a local Fuel network; - Crafting and signing transactions with hand-crafted scripts or contract calls; - Generating type-safe Rust bindings of contract methods; - And more, fuels-rs is still in active development.
